source_notes: Re-verify only, no change. GEM 'construction' status remains supported: the Iran LNG (NIOC LNG) project at Tombak Port was revived from 2021-2023 and was reported ~50-53% physically complete (Argus, Jan 2024; OGJ). No source documents a formal construction halt at the Tombak site. NOTE the project's near-term viability has deteriorated since GEM's 2025-09-03 update (UN snapback sanctions reimposed 28 Sep 2025; 2026 Iran war / Strait of Hormuz closure Mar 2026) — see status_timeline qa note. This single blue cell stands as the representative re-verify for the terminal; not repeated across T2/T3.
